post.description:
Clear the cookies and end the presented session on the server. Public on purpose
(an expired session must still be able to clear its cookies), so the session is
only revoked when the request proves it is ours: a Bearer header, or the HttpOnly
cookie with a valid CSRF token. The legacy UI clears its own stored token.

Change the password (behind the auth gate: needs a session, CSRF for cookies; no
machine key scope reaches it). Every older session ends; the caller gets a new one.

get.description:
Bundle the export CSV(s) + formula into a single ZIP.

Mobile browsers (esp. iOS Safari) allow only one download per tap and handle
blob downloads poorly, so the frontend hits this single
URL instead of firing several sequential downloads.

- all=true  -> all 4 timeframes (1w, 1d, 4h, 1h) part1+part2 + formula (9 files)
- interval=x -> that interval part1+part2 + formula (3 files)
Return token expiry info (not the token itself).

post.description:
Fetch XAUUSD across multiple timeframes + latest news, then ask Gemini for a
short-term (day/swing) entry plan with a concrete Long/Short strategy.

Kick off a server-side gold analysis (async). Notifies Telegram + uploads
the result to a timestamped Drive folder when done.

SymbolRef.description:
One {"symbol", "exchange"} entry. Extra keys (e.g. a display name) are kept, but the
two the server uses must be plain bounded strings — a dict such as {"$ne": null} can
never reach a Mongo filter.
